sources.title: Ling
sources.snippet: Ling-3.0-tiny Ling-3.0-tiny is a lightweight hybrid reasoning model in the Ling series designed for edge deployment scenarios, with 7.9B total parameters and only 1.3B activated parameters.

sources.title: Ling-3.0-tiny · Models
sources.snippet: We are introducing Ling-3.0-tiny, a lightweight hybrid reasoning MoE model with 7.9B total parameters and only 1.3B activated parameters per token. It is designed to deliver strong reasoning and agentic capabilities at low inference cost, making advanced model capabilities more accessible for local and resource-constrained deployment.

sources.title: Ling 3.0 Tiny - API Pricing & Benchmarks | OpenRouter
sources.snippet: Ling 3.0 Tiny is a mixture-of-experts model from InclusionAI, with 1.3B active parameters out of 7.9B total. It is designed for responsive agents, instruction following, and multi-turn conversations, with switchable thinking and instant modes.
